title: 05 Nights 06 Days Tour - Port Rivoli Hotel 3*
subtitle: FIT Program | Route: Baku – Gobustan – Absheron – Shahdag – Gabala
shortProgram:
05 nights 06 days 
Tour Program Description 
 
 
Day 1 Arrival in Baku 
Arrival in Baku International Airport, where guests will be welcomed by our representative and transferred comfortably to 
the hotel for check-in.  
Rest in the hotel 
 
Overnight in Baku. 
 
Day 2 Baku City Tour 
After breakfast at the hotel, proceed with a full-day Baku City Tour. The tour starts with a visit to Highland Park, offering 
panoramic views of the city and the Caspian coastline. Continue to the iconic Flame Towers, one of the modern symbols of 
Baku. Guests will then explore the historical Old City (Icherisheher), including its ancient streets and cultural landmarks. 
The tour also includes a photo stop at the famous Heydar Aliyev Center (photo stop), known for its unique modern 
architecture.  
Free time for shopping and leisure activities during the evening. 
Overnight in Baku 
 
 
Day 3 Gobustan & Absheron Tour 
Following breakfast, depart for the Gobustan & Absheron Tour. Begin the excursion with a visit to Gobustan National 
Park, famous for its ancient rock carvings, archaeological heritage, and historical atmosphere. Continue to the fascinating 
Mud Volcanoes, one of Azerbaijan’s most unique natural attractions. 
On the return from Gobustan, stop at the beautiful Bibiheybat Mosque, one of the most important religious landmarks in 
Azerbaijan, located near the Caspian Sea coast. Afterwards, continue towards the Absheron Peninsula to visit the Ateshgah 
Fire Temple, historically connected to ancient fire worshippers and Silk Road traders. The tour concludes with a visit to 
Yanardag, the legendary Burning Mountain where natural flames continuously rise from the hillside. Return to Baku in the 
evening 
 
Overnight in Baku. 
 
 
Day 4 Shahdag Tour 
After breakfast, depart for the Shahdag Mountain Resort, one of the most popular mountain destinations in Azerbaijan. 
Surrounded by the stunning Greater Caucasus Mountains, Shahdag offers beautiful landscapes, fresh air, and a relaxing 
atmosphere. Guests can enjoy free time for various mountain activities, scenic walks, cafés, and leisure experiences within 
the resort area. The tour is ideal for nature lovers and those wishing to experience the mountain side of Azerbaijan. Return 
to Baku in the evening.  
Overnight in Baku. 
 
Day 5 Gabala Tour 
Breakfast at the hotel followed by a full-day excursion to Gabala, one of Azerbaijan’s most beautiful regions surrounded 
by mountains and forests. During the tour, guests will visit Tufandag Mountain Resort and enjoy breathtaking views of the 
Caucasus Mountains. Continue to the peaceful Nohur Lake, known for its relaxing natural scenery, followed by a visit to 
the famous Seven Beauties Waterfall located within the green forest area. After enjoying the fresh mountain atmosphere 
and natural beauty of Gabala, return to Baku in the evening.  
Overnight in Baku. 
 
 
 
 
Day 6 DEPARTURE  
Breakfast at the hotel followed by check-out. According to the flight timing, guests will be transferred to the airport for their 
departure flight with unforgettable memories from Azerbaijan.
